reason: I do merge AI-written PRs and it does make me nervous, but I'm putting out fires all week and recording every scenario of our apps is a project, not a one-hour install. I'd star the repo and never get back to it.
objection: Recording scenarios sounds like more work than writing tests, and our apps have logins, SSO and test data I can't just replay. If masking and the first recording don't work on the first try, it's dead to me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it catch a real regression on one of our own apps in under an hour, from one command, with no scenario-writing on my side.
